diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on the same window and section assignments for V-17 as specified in PF1 (confirmed steering and brake requirement). This allowed C1 to pass despite A2 not having access to PF1, indicating a structural leak where the model defaulted to a specific window and section assignment for V-17.

C1.why: The confirmed steering and brake requirement changes V-17's window to exactly 0800-1000, assigns it to Motor Pool, and adds the dispatch hold control.
